name: Yellow Fruit Trees are No Longer Unlimited
description: The yellow fruit tree of the Cooking Pit no longer gives fruit without end. It holds at most 1,000 fruit and is refilled to full every 40 age units (4 hours of play on Normal speed, 2 on Fast, 6 hours 40 minutes on Slow), counted as the game counts its villagers' ages, so time away (as far as the game counts it) and Time Warp count too -- like A New Home's and The Lost Children's crops. Each fruit trip takes 3 fruit when its food is put in the food bin, and a stomped fruit that goes into the stew takes 3 when it is put in the pot; a failed Farming check or an interrupted trip takes nothing. While catching up, each Cooking Pit bonus takes 5 fruit, and pays nothing when fewer than 5 are left. With fewer than 3 fruit left, a villager dropped on the tree refuses, as at an empty blackberry bush ("Refusing", and "There is not enough to harvest." when it is the selected villager), and villagers deciding to farm are not sent there. Click the tree to see how much fruit is left ("Fruit remaining: N" on the game's own status line, as the blackberry bush shows its berries). A new village starts with a full tree. The count is kept beside the save, in Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Fruit Trees\Virtual Villagers 4 Yellow Fruit Tree - Save <S>.dat, written when the game saves; the save itself is never changed, so without this patch the tree is simply unlimited again. **Needs no other patch.** **Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it, and it is part of Classic VV Difficulty.** **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP VV4 Fruit Supply.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs.
behavior_changes: The tree's supply (0 to 1,000) is the companion's, per village; a new village (no file, or a file whose villagers are none of this village's: Start Over, another tribe in the slot) starts at 1,000.

Food-bin credit of a fruit trip (job event 15, 0x46456C): 3 fruit taken and the stock 3 food (x Food Mastery) credited; with fewer than 3 fruit, no food and nothing taken. Nothing is taken at the shake, the Farming check or the falling-fruit events.
Stew (the stomped fruit 0x37 dropped in the cauldron, the stew's listener 0x42EA30 -> 0x42EAE7): 3 fruit taken (down to 0) when the cauldron takes it, not when the trip decides to divert (0x4349A3).
Catch-up Cooking Pit bonus (0x468AAB): 5 fruit taken when it pays (its rand(100) is drawn as before); with fewer than 5, no food and no Farming practice check (0x468AB7..0x468AC5).

With fewer than 3 fruit: a villager dropped on the restored tree gets action 0x3F ("Refusing"; text 0xA7, "There is not enough to harvest.", on the status line when it is the selected villager), the empty blackberry bush's refusal (0x46F881..0x46F89C); the farming dispatcher does not add the fruit to its options (so rand(n) picks among the others, or none); a task 2 takes the empty bush's way out of the task gate (task cleared).

Refill: every age unit the life tick 0x468430 processes for one reference villager (the first processed, re-chosen when it dies or its record changes) counts; at 40 the tree is set to 1,000 and the count starts again. This is live and catch-up alike, so time away as the game's aging counts it (it clamps a long absence) and Time Warp both count.

Message 2 to the tree's area handler 0x435970 (the tree clicked; ignored by the stock game) shows "Fruit remaining: N" on the status line 0x4DB8E8 through 0x44C3A0, for 5 seconds, as the bush shows "Berries remaining: " (0x46F82A, text 0x115). The words go through VVFP Translations.dll (row vvfp.fruit_supply/vvfp_vv4_fruit_supply.on_click.s0).

The file Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Fruit Trees\Virtual Villagers 4 Yellow Fruit Tree - Save <S>.dat: magic 'VV4F', version 1, game 4, slot, fruit, age units since the last refill, the number of living villagers and their 256 identities by record (FNV-1a of gender, name and parents' names, as the Origins companion's); written atomically when the game saves the puzzles (CFruitwells slot 4), read after the game loads them (slot 3) and used only while at least one of its villagers is alive in the village. An unreadable file is never replaced; an invalid one is set aside.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes its 8 jumps and 2 vtable slots at run time, only after verifying every stock value, all or none; a different build installs nothing.
The save is never written, so removing the patch leaves the tree unlimited as in the stock game; the file stays beside the save, unused (Start Over empties the save's folder).
The trips, the Farming check and its practice, the stew, the bonus odds and amounts, Food Mastery and every other food source are the game's own.
